# Sparkfall Games
> Independent iOS apps & games. No ads, no tracking, honest one-time pricing, all data stays on-device.

## Apps
- [NumZen](https://sparkfallgames.com/numzen/): Three daily puzzles. The whole world plays.
- [Gloomfall](https://sparkfallgames.com/gloomfall/): Every enemy move is telegraphed.
- [QuickCost](https://sparkfallgames.com/quickcost/): Log an expense in 3 seconds.
- [Decibel Meter](https://sparkfallgames.com/decibelmeter/): Know your noise. Protect your hearing.
- [FastZen](https://sparkfallgames.com/fastzen/): The honest fasting timer.
